fields.description: Ollama runs a local vision model (Qwen2.5-VL): best for handwriting and register tables. Tesseract and PaddleOCR are lighter classic OCR engines (weaker on handwriting) — use Tesseract on Python 3.14, where PaddleOCR has no wheels.
fields.label: OCR Engine

fields.description: DocTypes that get an "Import from Photo" button on their list view. All OCR-eligible fields of each are read automatically.
fields.label: Enabled DocTypes

fields.description: Longest edge (px) the image is downscaled to before OCR. Lower = faster, higher = more detail.
fields.label: Max Image Dimension

fields.description: Base URL of the Ollama server. Use the Docker service name in production (http://ollama:11434).
fields.label: Ollama URL

fields.description: Vision model tag. Pull it once with: ollama pull qwen2.5vl:3b. Swap to qwen2.5vl:7b for better accuracy (slower, more RAM).
fields.label: Ollama Model

fields.description: Seconds to wait for the model before giving up.
fields.label: Request Timeout (s)

fields.description: Optional extra instructions appended to the auto-generated extraction prompt sent to the vision model.
fields.label: Extra Prompt Instructions

fields.description: Language code passed to PaddleOCR (e.g. en, ml, fr).
fields.label: Language

fields.description: Enable only if the bench host has a CUDA GPU and the GPU build of paddlepaddle is installed.
fields.label: Use GPU

fields.description: Tesseract language code(s), e.g. eng, mal, or eng+mal. The matching language data pack must be installed.
fields.label: Language
